lessons.key: surviving_mutant::tothrow mockrejectedvalue tomatchobject new httpexception msg status does not assert the http status code assert err getstatus tobe status so a status code mutation is killed at the unit layer not only at e2e
lessons.text: toThrow/MockRejectedValue + toMatchObject(new HttpException(msg, STATUS)) does not assert the HTTP status code; assert err.getStatus().toBe(STATUS) so a status-code mutation is killed at the unit layer, not only at e2e.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::nest test fixture get token is a ts type error when token is a symbol value not a type use the concrete class generic get inmemorycatalogclient and ensure tsconfig build does not exclude test files from the type check gate else ts2749 slips past build lint
lessons.text: Nest test fixture get<TOKEN> is a TS type error when TOKEN is a Symbol value, not a type; use the concrete class generic (get<InMemoryCatalogClient>) and ensure tsconfig.build does not exclude test files from the type-check gate, else TS2749 slips past build+lint.
